name: – After § 1 – Am 5
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Commission delegated regulation of 10 April 2026 amending Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/807 to introduce a trajectory to gradually decrease the contribution of high indirect land-use change-risk biofuels, bioliquids and biomass fuels to renewable energy targets
part_text: 1b. Stresses that soy cultivated within the European Union should, by definition, be considered a low ILUC‑risk feedstock, in light of the absence of deforestation impacts; emphasises, once again, that Union policies must avoid creating unjustified additional competitive disadvantages for the Union operators and carefully distinguish between feedstocks and uses so as not to undermine protein autonomy and the stability of the agri‑food sector in Member States;
